name: ExecuteExtraTool

tool_name.description: 已注册的目标工具名称、大小写变体或声明的别名（例如 mcp__cron__cron_list）；以当前会话目录为准

params.description: The parameters to pass to the target tool

description:
ExecuteExtraTool — a directly available meta tool in this session. 仅解析目标工具名称并委托执行，不增加权限或绕过审批。 You do NOT need to search for it.

This tool accepts a tool_name and params object, looks up the target tool in the current session's tool registry, and delegates execution to it. 目标工具可以是本地工具或远端 MCP 工具，保持与直接调用相同的权限和审批规则。

When to use: After SearchExtraTools discovers a deferred tool name, call this tool with {"tool_name": "<name>", "params": {...}} to invoke it immediately.
When NOT to use: For tools already in your tool list. Tools directly available in this session: Agent, AskUserQuestion, Bash, DiscoverSkillsTool, Edit, ExecuteExtraTool, Glob, Grep, Read, ReadContextArchive, SearchExtraTools, SkillTool, TodoWrite, WebFetch, WebSearch, Write, artifact, folder_operations.
